items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You see, Bebe and Celestine was together... [INTERVIEWEE] He was a young Tuxedo and a normal Tuxedo.

ctx.x: I was playing at the Hour Club. I was playing at the Hour Club. Sam Dutre, Marcel, Gilbert Jung, and I'm getting it was. Emma Barrett playing piano. Emma Barrett playing piano. That's right.

You see, Bebe and Celestine was together. Bebe was together in the separation. When he broke up, well, he took one part of the band and called it Bebe Ridley's Tuxedo and Celestine. He was Celestine. Yeah.
He was a young Tuxedo and a normal Tuxedo. In other words, that's what he used to call it.
